title: Identity-Locked Bridal Couture Story
description: A nine-image identity-locked portrait series for Bridal Couture Portrait Story, built from one reference portrait and eight dependent variations.
creative_direction: Portrait backlog lock: image 01 establishes the exact person for Bridal Couture Portrait Story; images 02-09 all depend on that reference and may vary only lighting, scene, wardrobe, pose, emotion, or grooming while preserving the same face, hair base, and body proportions.

generation_plan.ref_strategy: Run 01-reference-bridal-anchor first. Use its runtime result URL as --ref for 02-cover-portrait, 03-veil-closeup, 04-couture-full-body, 05-seated-atelier-portrait, 06-romantic-window-profile, 07-monochrome-emotion-frame, 08-fabric-detail-hands, 09-campaign-cover-crop. Queue may run 02-09 concurrently after 01 is done.
generation_plan.index_policy: Only status=done images with image.png are included in works/index.json.
